versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "thinking-systems" skill
- Provides a structured procedure for mapping and analyzing system behavior, focusing on boundaries, stocks/flows, feedback loops, and system archetypes
- Includes clear guidelines on when to use or not use systems mapping
- Supplies a step-by-step process for tracing problems to structural drivers and ranking interventions by leverage and side effects
- Defines a standardized output format for system analysis results
- Sets verification and over-application guards to prevent misapplication
